technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with strong volume and momentum confirmation, but price remains below intermediate moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent, government contracts and lobbying data unavailable, and earnings in 39 days present timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buying from junior members with small amounts; market fear (43 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lacks confirmatory signals.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (400), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising USD pressures multinational earnings, FOMC event just passed; earnings in 39 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + 15x volume spike + bullish OBV/Supertrend/PSAR create strong short-term momentum confirmation in a fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all intermediate moving averages (EMA/SMA 50) and Ichimoku cloud with stochRSI overbought, macro headwinds severe (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, USD headwind), earnings risk in 39 days, and fundamental/sentiment scores critically weak (3/4).
